name: EPIC 220698967

text.card: A red giant 2,483 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.09 solar masses and 12.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,627 K at its surface.
